_doc: Original prose written for this project. Copyright-clean, committed, and
therefore the corpus CI runs the wording rules against.
Why it exists: external_wording.json holds a third-party instrument's own
text and is git-ignored, so on CI its eight tests always skip — leaving the
three rules whose precision is least certain with zero coverage there.
This file closes that gap.
The two corpora are not interchangeable:
synthetic_wording.json  written by the rules' author. Style is imitated
from real questionnaires (neutral stems, hedged frequency wording,
trait statements, ordinary Chinese compounds containing 不). Because
the author wrote both the rules and the text, a clean result here is
partly circular — it proves the rules do not fire on plausible
questionnaire prose, not that they generalise.
external_wording.json   a real instrument, written by people who never
saw these rules. Only this one is external-validity evidence, and it
stays local.
So: this file is the CI regression guard; that one is the evidence.
Neither replaces the other. See docs/external-validity-check.md.
`expected_silent` lists the rules that must not fire on any stem here.
Items deliberately near a boundary carry a `near` note naming what they
brush against, so the corpus keeps its teeth.

stems.near: double_barreled: coordinator joining companions
stems.zh-CN: 过去一个月，您和同事一起使用本系统的次数大约是？

stems.near: double_barreled: compound concept
stems.zh-CN: 您如何评价本产品的性价比？

stems.near: double_barreled: joint quantifier
stems.zh-CN: 网页版和手机版您都用过吗？

stems.near: double_barreled: single evaluation object only
stems.zh-CN: 您对本次配送的速度是否满意？

stems.near: leading_question: contains 同意 with no position supplied
stems.zh-CN: 您在多大程度上同意下面这句话？

stems.near: leading_question: negative topic without a leading frame
stems.zh-CN: 您在下单过程中是否遇到过障碍？

stems.near: leading_question: asks for a judgement instead of asserting one
stems.zh-CN: 您认为当前的收费标准是否合理？

stems.near: double_negative: 不错 is one compound, not a negation
stems.zh-CN: 您觉得这次的界面改版效果不错吗？

stems.near: double_negative: 不同 is one compound
stems.zh-CN: 您对不同套餐的偏好有多强？

stems.near: double_negative: two negations, but split across clauses
stems.zh-CN: 这个功能不难上手，价格也没有超出预算。

stems.near: double_negative: a single plain negation
stems.zh-CN: 这项服务对您没有帮助吗？

stems.near: absolute_wording: hedged frequency
stems.zh-CN: 您通常隔多久会使用一次本服务？

stems.near: absolute_wording: hedged quantifier
stems.zh-CN: 大部分时候您会选择哪一种付款方式？

stems.near: absolute_wording: the low end of a frequency range
stems.zh-CN: 您有时会跳过引导页吗？

stems.near: jargon: acronym glossed on first use
stems.zh-CN: 本系统的 SDK（软件开发工具包）文档是否清楚？

stems.near: jargon: plain words for an ordinary process
stems.zh-CN: 您觉得退换货的办理过程是否顺畅？

stems.near: jargon: a business topic phrased in everyday language
stems.zh-CN: 您会再次向他人提起本产品吗？

stems.near: question_length: 38 characters, just inside the guideline
stems.zh-CN: 回想您最近一次使用本服务的经历，您认为整体流程是否顺畅呢？

stems.near: question_length: a short stem, the normal case
stems.zh-CN: 您使用本产品多久了？

stems.near: fabricated_citation: a year that is a time reference
stems.zh-CN: 2025 年您是否办理过会员？

stems.near: fabricated_citation: brackets carrying an instruction
stems.zh-CN: 请选择您常用的支付方式（可多选）。

stems.near: fabricated_citation: brackets marking an optional field
stems.zh-CN: 请写下您希望我们改进的地方（选填）。

stems.near: absolute_wording: trait-style stem without an absolute
stems.zh-CN: 我在网上购物前会先比较几家店铺。

stems.near: double_barreled: two nouns, only one is an evaluation object
stems.zh-CN: 您通过手机和电脑分别使用过本产品吗？

stems.near: nothing in particular: a plain demographic item
stems.zh-CN: 您目前所在的城市是？

stems.near: leading_question, English: neutral rating request
stems.en: How would you rate the checkout experience?

stems.near: double_barreled, English: compound concept
stems.en: How would you rate the balance between price and quality?

stems.near: double_barreled, English: companions
stems.en: Have you used this service together with your colleagues?

stems.near: jargon, English: capitalised sentence start, not an acronym
stems.en: Would you use this service again next month?

stems.near: question_length, English: 24 words, just inside the guideline
stems.en: Thinking only about the delivery of your most recent order and nothing else, how satisfied were you with the time it took?

stems.near: absolute_wording, English: hedged frequency
stems.en: How often do you usually open the mobile app?

stems.near: double_negative, English: a single plain negation
stems.en: Was the confirmation email not delivered to you?
